text.tspan: the picture is the page; over it, invisible,
A WORD IN CAPITALS is a role, a job
a page scanned twice read once
printed lines the first reading lacks
SORTER trees trained on golden books
rules: the book's run of chapter
reads a gap's misread number again
pick a version of each suspect
the scan crop beside each question
one dash and ellipsis style per book
small, light type at a page's foot,
opening on a mark, linked to
the mark in the text; a few lines
set in, alone on a page
ITALIC trees trained on golden books
dash length and gaps, ellipsis form
